subject: octagonal room beneath the Temple of Elemental Evil
fact: The octagonal room beneath the Temple of Elemental Evil glows with unnatural milky red light and is filled with swirling mist.
source_quote: The chamber glowed with an unnatural milky red light, swirling mist obscuring the polished gray floor shot through with glittering mica.

subject: processional hallway
fact: The processional hallway is painted with scenes of gross evil, death, and destruction.
source_quote: the processional hallway painted with scenes of gross evil, death, and destruction.

subject: bronze doors in the processional hallway
fact: Bronze doors lined the southern walls of the processional hallway, carved with vile scenes and runes.
source_quote: Bronze doors lined the southern walls, their polished surfaces carved with vile scenes and runes.

subject: white marble chamber
fact: The white marble chamber has walls and a vaulted ceiling sheathed in pearly alabaster.
source_quote: The floor was white marble, the walls and vaulted ceiling sheathed in pearly alabaster

subject: radiant figures
fact: Two radiant figures with wings of snowy feathers and radiant faces appeared in the white marble chamber.
source_quote: Two man-like creatures with wings of snowy feathers and radiant faces appeared amidst glowing, cloud-tinted billows

subject: radiant figures request weapons
fact: The brighter radiant figure asked the party to place every weapon, holy symbol, magic item, and silvered item before the crystal window.
source_quote: the party should place every weapon, holy symbol, magic item, and silvered item before the crystal window

subject: party refuses to surrender weapons
fact: The party refused to surrender more weapons despite the radiant figures' insistence.
source_quote: the party stood firm in their refusal

subject: radiant figures vanish
fact: The radiant figures vanished after declaring they would reserve their blessing for someone else.
source_quote: Disappointed, the angelic figures declared they would reserve their blessing for someone else and vanished

subject: secret room behind eastern door
fact: The secret room behind the eastern door had nesting heaps of cloth and pillows, bones and litter on the floor, and rust-red cloaks on pegs.
source_quote: a bare room permeated by a feral odor, with nesting heaps of cloth and pillows, bones and litter covering the floor, and rust-red cloaks hanging on pegs

subject: werewolves
fact: Two werewolves snarled at the party in the secret room.
source_quote: Inside were two werewolves who snarled at the intruders

subject: werewolves reveal trap
fact: One werewolf laughed and said the party could have been easier if they had dropped all their weapons.
source_quote: one of them laughed darkly, saying this could have been much easier if they had just dropped all their weapons and come in unarmed

subject: werewolves fight party
fact: The werewolves fought with savage ferocity, their claws and fangs tearing into the party.
source_quote: The werewolves fought with savage ferocity, their claws and fangs tearing into the party

subject: Calmer enchants weapons
fact: Calmer channeled divine energy to temporarily enchant Sequioa’s short sword and Zinnia’s spear with magical properties.
source_quote: Calmer called upon his divine power, channeling energy to temporarily enchant Sequioa’s short sword and Zinnia’s spear with magical properties

subject: Calmer's guardians burn werewolves
fact: Calmer’s radiant guardians materialized around him and burned the werewolves with holy light.
source_quote: Calmer’s radiant guardians materialized around him, burning the creatures with holy light

subject: Zinnia kills werewolf
fact: Zinnia landed a devastating blow with his enchanted spear, helping kill one of the werewolves.
source_quote: Zinnia landed a devastating blow with his enchanted spear

subject: party kills both werewolves
fact: The party brought down both werewolves in a fierce battle.
source_quote: together the party brought down both werewolves

subject: silver service
fact: The party found a silver service worth a considerable sum in the werewolves' lair.
source_quote: they discovered a silver service worth a considerable sum

subject: magical dagger
fact: The party found a magical dagger in the werewolves' lair.
source_quote: they found a magical dagger and short sword

subject: magical short sword
fact: The party found a magical short sword in the werewolves' lair.
source_quote: they found a magical dagger and short sword

subject: Zinnia discovers hidden treasure
fact: Zinnia discovered a loose flagstone that concealed a hidden treasure pile.
source_quote: Zinnia who made the most crucial discovery—a loose flagstone that concealed a hidden treasure pile

subject: silver pieces
fact: Beneath the loose flagstone, the party found silver pieces.
source_quote: beneath it lay silver pieces

subject: holy symbols of Saint Cuthbert and Rao
fact: Beneath the loose flagstone, the party found holy symbols of Saint Cuthbert and Rao.
source_quote: beneath it lay silver pieces, holy symbols of Saint Cuthbert and Rao

subject: five silver daggers
fact: Beneath the loose flagstone, the party found five silver daggers.
source_quote: beneath it lay ... five silver daggers

subject: nineteen silver-tipped arrows
fact: Beneath the loose flagstone, the party found nineteen silver-tipped arrows.
source_quote: beneath it lay ... nineteen silver-tipped arrows

subject: bone-covered hallway
fact: The bone-covered hallway contained skeletal warriors waiting to animate.
source_quote: moving silently through the bone-covered hallway where skeletal warriors lay waiting to animate

subject: Romag
fact: Romag was pleased to see the party alive after Dick Rentsch wagered they would not survive.
source_quote: Romag was pleased to see them alive, as Dick Rentsch had apparently wagered they would not survive

subject: Dick Rentsch
fact: Dick Rentsch admitted that Alremm had hired werewolves in the secret chamber as a test of the new recruits.
source_quote: Dick Rentsch ... admitted that Alremm had hired werewolves in the secret chamber as a test of the new recruits

subject: Romag awards Earth Temple badges
fact: Romag handed the party badges of the Earth Temple, declaring they had proven their worth.
source_quote: Romag handed them badges of the Earth Temple, declaring they had proven their worth

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer claimed to be a former cleric of Saint Cuthbert who had converted to the Earth Temple’s cause.
source_quote: Calmer boldly claimed to be a former cleric of Saint Cuthbert who had converted to the Earth Temple’s cause

subject: Lieutenant Krell
fact: Lieutenant Krell appeared with a mission from Romag to raid the Fire Temple.
source_quote: Lieutenant Krell appeared with a mission from Romag. The Fire Temple had seized a portion of their level, and the party was to raid them

subject: party kills Earth Temple ogre
fact: The party killed an ogre who turned out to be a member of the Earth Temple, not the Fire Temple.
source_quote: they surprised the creature, making quick work of the creature. but as they examined its body, a terrible realization dawned on them—the ogre was a member of the Earth Temple, not the Fire Temple

subject: party realizes betrayal
fact: The party realized they had been set up, and Lieutenant Krell was the most likely culprit.
source_quote: Someone had set them up, and the most likely culprit was Lieutenant Krell himself

subject: Lieutenant Krell
fact: Lieutenant Krell was conspicuously absent when the party returned to Romag to report the betrayal.
source_quote: When they arrived, Lieutenant Krell was conspicuously absent

subject: Romag
fact: Romag declared he had known Lieutenant Krell was a spy and had kept him under watch.
source_quote: Romag listened to their account, and his rage became palpable as he declared he had known the lieutenant was a spy and had kept him under watch

subject: Romag orders Krell captured alive
fact: Romag commanded the party to bring Lieutenant Krell to him alive so he could sacrifice him in the Temple of Earth.
source_quote: Romag commanded the party to bring the traitor to him alive so he could sacrifice him in the Temple of Earth as a warning to all who would dare betray them

subject: hunt for Lieutenant Krell
fact: The party now faces a mission to hunt down Lieutenant Krell, a treacherous spy.
source_quote: The party now faced a new mission: hunting down a cunning spy who had nearly gotten them killed
